profile.headline: Digital Artist
profile.summary:
I’m a multidisciplinary designer and web developer with more than ten years of experience building strategic, user-centered digital experiences. My work lives at the intersection of graphic design, branding, UX, and web development — where storytelling meets structure and creativity is guided by purpose.
With a foundation in Visual Communication from Lone Star College and advanced studies in Learning Technologies at University of North Texas, I bring both creative execution and project management strategy to every initiative. I’ve led website redesigns, built social media ecosystems from the ground up, produced multimedia content for a grant-funded program, and supported nonprofit organizations in expanding their digital presence.
I’m especially passionate about mission-driven work — recycling, community outreach, and nonprofit initiatives. Whether developing a brand identity, designing a campaign, or building a website infrastructure, I focus on creating cohesive digital experiences that engage audiences and deliver measurable impact.
If you're looking for a designer who understands both aesthetics and systems — someone who can move from concept to launch with clarity and intention — let’s connect.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Execute all visual design stages from concept to final delivered product. Maintain strict schedules to achieve every goal set forth in contract agreements. Stay up-to-date with the latest web trends, techniques and technologies while solving problems creatively and effectively. Passionate brand builder pushing superior user experience forward across all digital touchpoints.
positions.insights: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), HTML5 and +12 skills

positions.title: Social Media Director
positions.description:
Hired to establish an internet presence for the Woodlands
office. After I made repeated requests for updates to our office
website, I was asked to assist Derek Peterson, corporate
website project manager, in the redesign of all content and
organization.

Initiated social media profiles. Created upbeat and original
content adhering to brand standards to engage a growing
viewership. Actively sought out and joined industry-specific
organizations with shared interests and values.

Recognized as Brand Ambassadors out of 400+ hard-working
offices in the Right at Home franchise during my last month
with the office. Their following now grows organically.
positions.insights: Office Equipment, Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +40 skills

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description:
I was privileged to be offered a CO-OP student worker position in my last semester at Lone Star. Our team was tasked with creating a video to highlight all the wonderful programs the school was able to create and maintain as a result of the Title V Grant we were awarded. 

In this role I: 
- Assisted in location set-up and talent recruitment. 
- Wrote all text and title graphics for the film. 
- Learned how to use Adobe After Effects in order to create a moving logo for the school. 
- Assisted in maintaining the file system and backups for the project.

My position was limited to one semester or I would certainly be employed there still. I worked with the greatest people in my favorite atmosphere. I will be forever grateful to have been offered this opportunity.
positions.insights: Office Equipment, Logo Design and +23 skills
